decisions: Named declarations and direct/interpolated/trait/dyn/CPU calls put shared runtime pointer slots first, followed by async diagnostic parent, captures and declared inputs. Foreign C ABI callbacks and calls retain their ABI.

Root owns stdin/stdout handles and i32 written/read plus i1 ok_state. Ordinary functions forward values, async factories save the pointers in shared prefix slots and worker/cancel callbacks restore them.

Compute groups already reserve fields6..10: store real runtime pointers there. Worker callbacks load them and tag the item memory sink as stdout. Source functions must consume explicit stdout and counters, with no TLS fallback.
Runtime helper text output must consume passed stdout/written/ok_state, including tagged memory sinks. Keep raw foreign functions separate.

Expose the generated slot enum as a dependency-only module so runtime and text emitters consume one CSharp authority. Canonical compiler manifests include the projection. Retained fixture graphs require a later declared dependency audit; do not edit original expected assertions.

Original48 also fixes the source ABI primary parameter spelling %it. CSharp ExplicitParameterListForFunction uses %it; preserve Native internal %arg via a typed entry freeze for ordinary nonbounded values and async factories. No oracle edits.
